audit_requests.finding: persistTranslatedPage rejection still allowed completion accounting; subsequent retry handling also lost original restore metadata or could leave DOM/storage out of sync.
audit_requests.current_evidence: Pre-fix run 36959749640 completed the batch after persist_failed. Intermediate runs exposed duplicate persistence, stale DOM after retry, and missing originalUrl/cleanUrl/size metadata.
audit_requests.missing_evidence: A failed persistence must leave the batch active; only a successful retry may account the index, with original metadata and DOM synchronized after persistence success.
audit_requests.why_needed: Persistence is the commit boundary. Counting failed commits or retrying without restore metadata can report false completion and corrupt restore state.
audit_requests.requested_action: Do not account on catch; make retry explicit; preserve metadata; update DOM only after successful retry persistence.
audit_requests.expected_evidence: Failure leaves batch active and silent; retry makes exactly one persistence attempt, preserves restore metadata, updates DOM, then completes once.
audit_requests.expected_auditor_action: Reaudit persistence failure/retry, restore metadata and DOM/storage consistency.
audit_requests.possible_regression: False success after storage failure; duplicate writes; retry loses restore identity or shows content different from persisted content.
audit_requests.impact: Batch correctness, persistence integrity, restore behavior and success audio.
audit_requests.audit_finding: Found while extending async persistence adversarial coverage after 191-015.
audit_requests.resolution: catch no longer accounts completion; failed batchId:index keys gate retry; retry metadata is snapshotted and reused; retry DOM changes only after successful persistence.

audit_requests.finding: Using translated=true plus active batch as the retry predicate misclassified duplicate UPDATE_IMAGE messages inside a multi-image active batch as persistence retries.
audit_requests.current_evidence: Run 36960491357 returned domApplied:true for the duplicate index while the batch was still active.
audit_requests.missing_evidence: Only an index that actually produced PERSIST_FAIL in the same batch may use the special retry path.
audit_requests.why_needed: Duplicate delivery is normal in async messaging and must not replace a valid translated image or rewrite persistence merely because the batch has other pending images.
audit_requests.requested_action: Track failed persistence by batchId:index and require that key for retry.
audit_requests.expected_evidence: Active duplicate keeps original DOM, returns domApplied:false, does not complete early; true failed persistence retry remains functional.
audit_requests.expected_auditor_action: Reaudit duplicate-vs-retry identity in multi-image batches.
audit_requests.possible_regression: Duplicate payload silently replaces the first valid result while other images are still processing.
audit_requests.impact: DOM correctness, idempotency, persistence and multi-image batch integrity.
audit_requests.audit_finding: Found after c5ed7b9 fixed post-completion duplicates but still treated any translated image in an active batch as retry.
audit_requests.resolution: _failedPersistenceUpdateKeys and _failedPersistenceUpdateMeta gate the retry path. Ordinary duplicates no longer mutate DOM/accounting.
